fields.System.Title: INV-302 — Validate the destination location
fields.System.Description:
Story

As a developer, I want the destination checked before stock is moved into it, so that
stock never ends up somewhere illegal, however it was requested.

Acceptance criteria

  • - Given a blocked or retired destination, then the move is rejected.
  • - Given a destination that would exceed its max weight or max volume, then the move is
  • rejected with the limit named.
  • - Given a destination that does not allow product mixing and already holds another product,
  • then the move is rejected.
  • - Given a destination that does not allow batch mixing and already holds another batch,
  • then the move is rejected.
  • - Given a product with a temperature or hazmat class, then the destination zone must
  • permit it.
  • - Given a validation failure, then the error names the rule that failed, so the operator
  • knows what to do instead.

Traceability

| Aspect | Detail |
|---|---|
| Modules | inventory, masterdata |
| Tables | stock_balance, location, product |
| Risks | Null capacity making validation impossible ([doc 03 §7.4](../../../docs/03-master-data.md)); wrong temperature class causing spoilage ([doc 03 §7.6](../../../docs/03-master-data.md)) |
| Tests | unit · integration |
